consequence.statement: Istio resources now include standardized Kubernetes recommended labels; label selectors, filters, and monitoring rules that depend on these labels being absent or different may be affected.

original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the Kubernetes recommended labels app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/part-of, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, and helm.sh/chart to almost all resources.

decision.reason: [ev-d4a0f83c6c05] only says that six standard labels (the app.kubernetes.io/* labels and helm.sh/chart) were added to almost all resources. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so a mandatory-work kind has no support. The deployed resources do change after the upgrade, which makes a low-severity behavior-change for review defensible. The statement's point about selectors or monitoring rules being affected is hedged with "may", and the evidence does not show it.
